import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the dynamic libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the necessary GSL types and functions
class gsl_matrix_complex(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('size1', ctypes.c_size_t), ('size2', ctypes.c_size_t), ('data', ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double))]

class gsl_vector(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('size', ctypes.c_size_t), ('data', ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double))]

class gsl_eigen_herm_workspace(ctypes.Structure):
    pass

gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(gsl_matrix_complex)
gsl.gsl_vector_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(gsl_vector)
gsl.gsl_eigen_herm_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(gsl_eigen_herm_workspace)

gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
gsl.gsl_vector_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]
gsl.gsl_eigen_herm_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]

gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_set.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_matrix_complex), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_vector_get.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_vector), ctypes.c_size_t]
gsl.gsl_vector_get.restype = ctypes.c_double
gsl.gsl_eigen_herm.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_matrix_complex), ctypes.POINTER(gsl_vector), ctypes.POINTER(gsl_eigen_herm_workspace)]

gsl.gsl_eigen_herm_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_eigen_herm_workspace)]
gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_matrix_complex)]
gsl.gsl_vector_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_vector)]

def compute_eigenvalues(matrix):
    n = len(matrix)
    A = gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_alloc(n, n)
    eval = gsl.gsl_vector_alloc(n)
    w = gsl.gsl_eigen_herm_alloc(n)

    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_set(A, i, j, matrix[i][j].real, matrix[i][j].imag)

    gsl.gsl_eigen_herm(A, eval, w)

    eigenvalues = [gsl.gsl_vector_get(eval, i) for i in range(n)]

    gsl.gsl_eigen_herm_free(w)
    gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_free(A)
    gsl.gsl_vector_free(eval)

    return sorted(eigenvalues)

def assert_test():
    matrix = [[1.0 + 0.0j, 0.0 + 0.0j], [0.0 + 0.0j, 2.0 + 0.0j]]
    expected_eigenvalues = [1.0, 2.0]
    result = compute_eigenvalues(matrix)
    assert np.allclose(result, expected_eigenvalues), f"Expected {expected_eigenvalues}, got {result}"

    matrix = [[2.0 + 0.0j, 0.0 + 0.0j], [0.0 + 0.0j, 3.0 + 0.0j]]
    expected_eigenvalues = [2.0, 3.0]
    result = compute_eigenvalues(matrix)
    assert np.allclose(result, expected_eigenvalues), f"Expected {expected_eigenvalues}, got {result}"

    matrix = [[5.0 + 0.0j, 0.0 + 0.0j], [0.0 + 0.0j, 1.0 + 0.0j]]
    expected_eigenvalues = [1.0, 5.0]
    result = compute_eigenvalues(matrix)
    assert np.allclose(result, expected_eigenvalues), f"Expected {expected_eigenvalues}, got {result}"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
